reasons.correctness: SupportTicket gains `@Version private Long version`. The changeset adds `version BIGINT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL` to support_ticket and is included in changelog.xml. Build is green, hidden tests pass 2/2 and existing tests pass 229/229.

reasons.test_quality: The agent added no tests (0/0). It only ran the existing SupportTicket unit tests. Nothing asserts the @Version field or the versioning behaviour.
reasons.graph_use: One graph query listed the support/ticket files up front. After that, the reference example and the changeset pattern were found through repeated grep for @Version, version and applied_opportunity, not through the graph.
